Confirmed bug: `lib/coldemail/templates.ts` has 7 reusable templates across categories ("Hosting switch," "Web design," "Game servers," "General outreach," "Follow-up"), 18 steps total, each with `{{firstName}}`/`{{company}}` merge-var body copy. The file's own header comment states the intended design: "at most one link in the opener." But NONE of the 18 steps actually contain a markdown link (`[text](url)`) — confirmed via grep, zero matches. This means every cold email sent from these templates has no clickable CTA at all, even though the sending pipeline (`lib/coldemail/sender.ts`) already fully supports it: `markdownToHtml()` converts `[label](url)` to real HTML links, and `injectTracking()` automatically wraps every link (except the required unsubscribe link) through click-tracking redirects at send time. This is a pure content-authoring gap, not a technical limitation.

Your job:
1. Read `lib/coldemail/templates.ts` fully to see all 7 templates/18 steps and their categories/tone.
2. For each template category, identify the correct real landing-page link to use:
   - "Hosting switch" category → likely `/vps` or a relevant `vps-vs-X`/`migrate-from-X` comparison page depending on the specific step's angle (read each step's copy to pick the most relevant real page — check `app/sitemap.ts` for exact real routes)
   - "Web design" category → check if there's a real live web-design-adjacent service page (e.g. `/web-hosting` if the pitch is hosting-adjacent, or something else if Nxeon actually offers web design — verify before assuming, don't link to a page that doesn't match the pitch)
   - "Game servers" category → `/game-servers` (the real hub page)
   - "General outreach" / "Follow-up" → likely a generic strong landing page like `/vps` or `/pricing`, or match to whatever the specific step's copy is actually pitching
3. For each of the 18 steps, add exactly ONE natural, low-key markdown link into the body copy — matching the tone of a real cold email, not a marketing blast (e.g., "Worth a look before your next renewal? [Here's what we offer](https://nxeon.cloud/vps)." or working the link naturally into an existing sentence). Do NOT add multiple links per step, do NOT add a logo or heavy CTA button — this should stay looking like a personal email, per the file's own stated design intent. Use the real production domain (nxeon.cloud) for all links.
4. Run `npx tsc --noEmit`, confirm clean.

Separately: the specific live campaign the owner was reviewing ("Local Businesses — Shared Hosting (Variant A)", subject "quick one, Avenue Right") is a CUSTOM campaign stored in the `SequenceStep.bodyMarkdown` DB column on PROD (not sourced from this template library — confirmed it doesn't match any of the 7 templates). This task is staging-file-only; you do NOT have access to fix that specific live prod campaign row. Just note in your report that it exists as a separate, uncommitted fix the owner/main session needs to handle directly via a DB update (target: add `[worth a look?](https://nxeon.cloud/web-hosting)`-style link into that specific campaign's body, matching the same natural-link style you use in the templates).

Report back (table, under 400 words): each of the 18 steps → link added (target URL) → confirm it fits the step's actual pitch, and final `tsc` status.
